nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, every group $G$ in which any two elements generate a finite subgroup, and every element $a \in G$ such that any two conjugates of $a$ generate a $p$-subgroup, there is a normal $p$-subgroup of $G$ containing $a$. Here a $p$-subgroup is a subgroup in which every element has order a power of $p$.
nodes.title: Baer–Suzuki theorem for binary finite groups

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every prime $p$, every group $G$ in which any two elements generate a finite subgroup, and every element $a \in G$ such that any two conjugates of $a$ generate a $p$-subgroup, there is a normal $p$-subgroup of $G$ containing $a$. Here a $p$-subgroup is a subgroup in which every element has order a power of $p$.
nodes.title: Baer–Suzuki property for binary finite groups

nodes.summary: There is a group $G$ in which every element has finite order, together with an element $a \in G$ such that any two conjugates of $a$ generate a finite $2$-subgroup, but no normal $2$-subgroup of $G$ contains $a$. Here a $2$-subgroup is a subgroup in which every element has order a power of $2$.
nodes.title: Failure of the Baer–Suzuki theorem for periodic groups at the prime 2

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every group $G$ in which every element has finite order and every element $a \in G$ such that any two conjugates of $a$ generate a finite $2$-subgroup, there is a normal $2$-subgroup of $G$ containing $a$. Here a $2$-subgroup is a subgroup in which every element has order a power of $2$.
nodes.title: Baer–Suzuki property for periodic groups at the prime 2

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group, $p$ a prime and $x \in G$. Then $x$ lies in the $p$-core $O_p(G)$ of $G$ if and only if, for every $g \in G$, the subgroup of $G$ generated by $x$ and $g x g^{-1}$ is a $p$-group, that is, every element of it has order a power of $p$.
nodes.title: Baer–Suzuki theorem

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$ and a group $G$, the $p$-core $O_p(G)$ is the supremum, in the lattice of subgroups of $G$, of all normal subgroups $N$ of $G$ that are $p$-groups, that is, such that every $y \in N$ satisfies $y^{p^k} = 1$ for some $k \ge 0$.
nodes.title: The $p$-core of a group

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
